# Example subagents

The fixture's stand-in for `.claude/agents/README.md`. An index, so the README row governs
it and not the `Reference — agents` cell — the cell-extent rule
(`docs/plans/2026-09-02-w37-rfc-readme-row-and-stamp-set.md` §2): *a cell governs what its
text names; an index is the README row's*. Both routes give `lead` here, which is why the
value alone would not have told anyone whether the rule was applied.
